game_state_writes: Phase writes Subpixel only; SetTile writes the indexed world byte only. Mace/tile/collision queries preserve game state. Software-stack pointer and adjacent canaries checked.
cycle_scope: Includes identical sim65 counter-call measurement overhead; no mapper thunk. Not NES frame-rate evidence.
limit: Finite actual sim6502/C/UIL arithmetic/ABI vectors, not exhaustive global-game proof. Final banked NES integration and timing are separate gates.

coverage.phase: All 256 low bytes at Anim high bytes 0,1,127,128,255; adjacent canaries and software stack preserved.
coverage.maces: All 256 angles × all 48 legal slots × centers 0,127,255; both X/Y returned coordinates compared, entire object array preserved. Y negates signed word before arithmetic shift.
coverage.tiles: All 65,536 byte-coordinate pairs: GetTile/GetCollision plus SetTile; all 256 collision-table indices also exercised. Private full 256-byte collision ROM window, no tile-ID clamping.
coverage.collision: 25,600 single-axis vectors (all wrapped deltas × 10 radii × 5 centers × 2 axes), 76,800 combined boundary vectors, 900 jump/death guard vectors. Radii include 0,127,128,255.
coverage.typed_uil: Separate actual typed-UIL evaluator checks against independent byte/bit/signed-interval calculations and exact decoded ROM words. Counts are per state/vector, with two mace return checks and three tile operations each.

previous_phase_only.note: Historical phase-only artifact; superseded by this seven-entry intrinsic artifact. Page placement changes counter-included cycle totals.
